example_sentences_in_bangla: তার চেহারা মরা খেকোর মতো কুশ্রী।
এই ছবিটি মরা খেকোর মতো অসুন্দর লাগছে।
example_sentences_in_english: His appearance is as ugly as a dead turtle.
This picture looks as ugly as a dead turtle.
note: The idiom uses the image of a dead turtle to convey extreme unattractiveness, drawing from everyday rural observations in Bengali culture.
